@everyone ⚠️ IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT – SECURITY WARNING

Dear Members,

We have received reports that a fake bot is impersonating ZET_Zeus and sending advertisements and unwanted messages to members.

🚨 PLEASE BE CAREFUL!

- Do NOT trust messages sent by suspicious accounts pretending to be ZET_Zeus.
- Do NOT click on suspicious links.
- Do NOT respond to or interact with these advertising messages.
- Do NOT share personal information with unknown accounts.
- Please report and block the suspicious bot immediately.

IMPORTANT: I am NOT responsible for any advertisements, links, or messages sent by this fake bot. It is not authorized by me or the ZET administration.

If you receive such a message, please report it to the administration immediately.

We take the security of our community seriously. Thank you for your attention and cooperation.

👑 ZET ADMINISTRATION – ZET_Zeus

⚠️ STAY ALERT. PROTECT YOUR ACCOUNT. TRUST ONLY OFFICIAL ZET ANNOUNCEMENTS.
